purpose: Ask permission to perform an action yourself.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Please let me go home early today.
Please let me read this book.
Please allow me to explain once more.
restrictions: The listener is asked to allow the speaker to act.
mistake: It differs from asking the listener to perform the base action.
